# Local Boost Lab

> Local Boost Lab is an automated Google Business Profile management service for local service businesses. It replies to reviews, publishes posts on the profile and sends a monthly report. English site for the United States; Spanish site for Colombia at /es-co.

## Plans (United States, billed in USD, no contract)
- Reputation: $97 per month
- Presence: $157 per month
- Authority: $217 per month
- Details and what each plan includes: https://localboostlab.com/pricing

## Colombia
- One plan at COP 425.000 per month, no contract: https://localboostlab.com/es-co/precios
- Spanish home: https://localboostlab.com/es-co

## Who it is for
HVAC companies, dental practices, law firms, cleaning companies and other local service businesses.

## Not to be confused with
Local Boost Lab (localboostlab.com) is not related to Local Boost Networking, Boosted Lab or LocalBoostly.
